title: Tank Safety: Hydrogen Tank Gunshot | Toyota
summary: Toyota's short promo clip showing a Mirai carbon-fiber hydrogen tank shot with a .50 caliber round at point blank range. The bullet pierces the tank, which does not burst, and the gas simply escapes and disperses.
why: Cited in hydrogen debates as evidence that pressurized hydrogen tanks do not necessarily explode when punctured.

quote.text: The bullet pierced the tank, but it didn't go kaboom. The hydrogen just leaked out.
